summary: Read a string of capital English letters together with a nonnegative integer k. Any character may be changed into a different capital letter, and the number of changes cannot pass k. After those changes, look for a contiguous slice whose characters are all one letter. Write the greatest length such a slice can reach. Both the string length and k stay at most 10000.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
